in_sanskrit.name: जयन्ती
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who brings victory and triumphs over obstacles.

in_marathi.name: Jayanti
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jayanti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jayanti is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Jayanti', meaning 'victory' or 'triumph'. This name is associated with the goddess Durga, who symbolizes the power of victory over evil. It is also a name given to children born during Diwali, the Hindu festival of lights.
